body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 30a4ba58c7f04cb7a8a646bd22dcc3701ecb93bb -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a re-review of head `30a4ba5`. The two requests from the review of `a637e91` are done.

What looks good:

- The advice cache key in `crates/ui/src/height_memo.rs` now contains the effective machine kind from `machine::kind_of_setup`. Two new tests change the document machine from mill to lathe and back, and from lathe to mill and back. Both tests also make sure that unchanged frames use the cached advice.
- The PR body has before and after screenshots of the Heights tab for the same contour, stock and heights. The PNG files are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch (commit `78abec3`). The PR branch has no images.
- The key covers all inputs that `creation_advice` reads: the tilt, the kind, the machine kind, the setup definitions, the stock and model bodies, the resolved heights, the program order with suppression, the units, the source and the draft parameters.
- The change is display only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No goldens changed. No snapshot PNGs changed.
- There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in production code. The decision file `docs/decisions/2131-clearance-stock-advice.md` records the cache key and the review fix. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2131`.

Results, local, trial-merged with upstream main `0727d7e9b30745d8c466cbaa93e1874245c5b792`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (parallel): 1121 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. The failure is `diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level`, at `crates/ui/src/diag.rs:139`:

  ```text
  the note is an INFO event: ... WARN camcraft_ui: gpu: test adapter failed: no surface - trying the next adapter
  ```

  A GPU test that ran at the same time wrote this event. The test passed when it ran alone (3 of 3 `diag::tests` passed). The last review saw the same failure on the upstream baseline. This PR does not change `diag.rs`.
- All five new tests passed. The `setup_mount_pages` test that failed in the last review passed in this parallel run.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Mutations (each one reverted after the run):
  1. Set `machine_kind` in the key to the constant `Kind::Mill`: both `drill_advice_follows_document_machine_*` tests failed (red). After the revert, they passed (green).
  2. Remove the Heights tab guard in `params_page.rs` (`tab != usize::MAX`): `clearance_stock_advice_is_only_on_heights_and_covers_new_drafts` failed at "Geometry does not show Heights advice" (red). After the revert, all 13 `clearance_stock_advice` and `height_memo` tests passed (green).

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):

1. The commits use `fix(ui)`, but issue #2131 has the `enhancement` label. A `feat` merges at the cut, and a `fix` merges when the review is clean. The maintainer can decide which type applies.
2. The issue asks for the sentence "beside Clearance". The page shows it at the end of the Heights tab, below Stepdown (see the after screenshot). This is acceptable, but a later change can move it to the Clearance group.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
